Acid Rain Acid rain is a major environmental problem throughout the industrialized world. One major source is the burning of fossil fuels containing sulfur (coal, oil, and natural gas). The sulfur dioxide released into the air dissolves in water or, more seriously, may be oxidized further to sulfur trioxide. The SO3 dissolves in water to form sulfuric acid:
